{{Quote|You are on your own for finding the last camp. Trig Longo thinks it is in the research and prison facility...but I don't think anyone would have lived at that location long after the virus outbreak.|[[Jeb Maris]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
'''Camp Epsilon''' was one of five refugee camps established within the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] following an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]] of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|There are other camps just like this. The only location I know coordinates to is a hold out camp of Stormtrooper 'Ims' at the Research and Prison Facility. Ground zero to the virus.|[[Trig Longo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Trig|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Research_and_Prison_Facility.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> an accident happened in an [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was secretly conducting dangerous scientific research to engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. The virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment and turned most of the people in the area in flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. The Empire promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the virus outbreak, mostly Imperial staff and prisoners, were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. They established five camps inside the area, [[Camp Alpha]], [[Camp Beta]], [[Camp Gamma]], [[Camp Delta]] and Camp Epsilon, in order to try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation,<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> albeit all rescue teams were attacked upon landing in the area and their members were killed before they could find the survivors.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The camps were named by the [[TIE pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]] who had managed to deliver radios from Camp Alpha to the other camp and had established communication between them.<ref name="SWG:DR" />

[[File:Zsu_Val_Camp_Epsilon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Zsu Val]] defending Camp Epsilon.]]
Camp Epsilon was made of a few tents surrounded by a protective wall consisting of concrete slabs, large disabled devices and other waste materials. It was inhabited by a ragtag group of survivors made of Imperial troopers, ex-prisoners and soldiers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> and the defense was led by the former prisoner [[Zsu Val]]. Indeed, the camp came under regular attack from the zombies and the refugees had to struggle for their survival.<ref name="SWG:FWEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Epsilon Camp|Dathomir}}</ref> Other survivors included the technician [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> the mechanic [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]],<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> and a small contingent of immune [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]<ref name="SWG:StT" /> including [[GT-643]], [[KD-121]] and their leader [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Stormtroopers|Dathomir}}</ref> Contrary to the four other refugee camps that were located in random places of the Quarantine Zone, Camp Epsilon was located in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility. In fact, the camp was established around the last [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the area, a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], that was not destroyed during the outbreak. However, the ship was damaged and was not able to fly. HX-138 expected to find a way to fix the shuttle in order to allow the survivors to escape the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:SP" />

A group of spacers visited Camp Epsilon during their journey in the Quarantine Zone. They assisted the survivors in their fight against the undeads<ref name="SWG:FWEC" /> and helped the stormtroopers in rescuing some survivors<ref name="SWG:RS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Rescue Survivor|Dathomir}}</ref> and finding parts to fix the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> The spacers later left Camp Epsilon to enter the Imperial Research and Prison Facility in order to obtain an original sample of the Blackwing virus.<ref name="SWG:AA" /> The spacers survived to their exploration of the research facility and finally came back to Camp Epsilon with a group of survivors found in the laboratories. In the meantime, Nils Cridmeen was able to repair the ''Lambda''-class shuttle. The refugees of Camp Epsilon, the survivors from the research facility and the spacers eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone altogether with the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Camp Epsilon was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CLC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Camp Epsilon was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
